name: lg_blackbird_story_poked
doc: Stands in for saves/blackbird_re/ff23_story_poked.state (and the captures made from it): the attract's own hand-off at loc 06B under today's rule (attract_entry3_handoff, power-on + 8776) with the story's two bytes put back -- $7F0057 bit 2 (the attract) cleared, the storyline $7F0000 = D3 -- as the capture was made from the older rule's f8859 state: scene 107's controller then takes the story's arm, `DD F6` on f21 and `FF 23` on f26 (the capture's frames; sequence_table.md sec. 14).
